_comment: Limits the checks apply. Each value cites its source in the knowledge; checks/test verifies that the source states it. No command-line option or environment variable changes them.

peak_rss_kib.source: [CC1-PN §3] Peak resident memory (RSS) during the recorded drive: 8 MiB

threads_at_end.source: [CC1-PN §3] Threads at the end of the replay: at most 4

log_time_window_ms.source: [CC1-PN §6.3] t_ms differ by at most 20 ms

log_ignored_fields.source: [CC1-PN §6.2] Ignored: the version field of SERVICE_START

sysroot.source: [CC1-PN §7.2] the sysroot of the Buildroot build; reference-project/README.md: expected in /opt/cc1-sysroot

needed_library.source: [CC1-PN §4.2] readiness is reported with sd_notify("READY=1") from libsystemd
